notes.title: [Development Update] New Cinematic Control System Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p][b]\[Development Update] New Cinematic Control System for Animations Coming Soon!

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/39bef2210377cf94fbe20bc0cd9a653ebd586888.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We wanted to share a sneak peek at something we've been cooking up based on your feedback - a new [b]multi-scene animation control system[/b] that we're implementing for more complex cinematic sequences![/p][p][b]How It Works:[/b] As you can see in the preview, this new system allows for seamless navigation through multi-camera angles and different character poses within the same animation sequence. The progression system works like this:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Scenes 1-3[/b]: Viewed and unlocked (available for replay)[/p][/*][*][p]▶️ [b]Scene 4[/b]: Currently viewing[/p][/*][*][p]🔓 [b]Scene 5[/b]: Unlocked but not yet viewed (new content ready!)[/p][/*][*][p]🔒 [b]Scene 6[/b]: Locked (requires progression)[/p][/*][/list][p]This gives you more control over your viewing experience while maintaining the sense of discovery and progression that's core to the game.

You can now choose between:[/p][list][*][p][b]Full (0s)[/b] - No delay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick (1.5s)[/b] - Default setting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cinematic (3.5s)[/b] - Recommended for best experience![/p][/*][*][p][b]Minimum (6s)[/b] - Maximum delay between animations[/p][/*][/list][p]You can find this in the Settings menu under the Pacing section. While Quick is enabled by default, we recommend trying the Cinematic pacing for the intended experience. We've also [b]increased the font size[/b] of all settings labels for better readability![/p][p][b]Quality Updates:[/b] In our commitment to delivering the best experience possible:[/p][list][*][p]We've [b]removed 4 animations[/b] (including some car and zoom sequences) that weren't meeting our quality standards[/p][/*][*][p]Currently [b]reworking 5 animations[/b] to fix eye tracking inconsistencies and improve overall quality[/p][/*][*][p][b]These animation fixes will be patched in within the next few days to a week![/b] 🔧[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify these issues! 🙏[/p][p][b]When Can You Expect This?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pacing Control[/b]: Available NOW in today's update![/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation fixes[/b]: Coming in the next few days to a week[/p][/*][*][p][b]New cinematic control system[/b]: Rolling out around [b]Episode 2 or potentially a bit earlier[/b] if testing goes smoothly[/p][/*][/list][p]What do you think about this new approach to cinematic sequences? Would you like more granular control over multi-scene animations? Let us know in the comments below![/p][p]Thanks for your continued support and patience as we polish these features![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - UI & Cinematic Improvements
notes.content:
Thanks to the valuable feedback from our community survey, we've implemented several important changes to improve your experience:
What's New:

Animation Pacing Controls - Added new "Pacing" settings in Preferences, giving you complete control over animation timing:

Standard (1.5s) - Default
Cinematic (3.5s) - For dramatic effect
Instant (no pause) - For speed runners
Director's Cut (10s) - The full cinematic experience


Improved UI Readability - Increased menu label font sizes from 16 to 22 for better visibility and accessibility
Day 1 Animation Fixes - Resolved multiple animation timing and transition issues in the opening chapter

Based on Your Feedback:
Your survey responses were eye-opening - 47.9% wanted MORE animations while 31.3% felt there were too many. Rather than pick a side, we've given everyone what they want:

Removed repetitive car animations that interrupted story flow
Polish pass on existing animations for smoother transitions
Full player control - YOU decide the pacing that works for you

Coming Soon:

Additional animation refinements
Further UI improvements
More accessibility options

The split in feedback showed us there's no one-size-fits-all approach. That's why we've focused on customization - letting you tailor the experience to your preferences.
Thank you for your continued support and honest feedback. Keep it coming!

notes.title: 🛠️ Developer Update – Day 4/6 in Production + New Character Tease!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/5a2ed584eb45bdeb0f93e6ef27d6d88cc6b61819.jpg[/img]

We’re deep in production on the final day of the upcoming release — and it’s shaping up to be one of our most ambitious chapters yet.

To give you a small taste, here’s a look at one of Sofia’s new outfits from the build. We’ll let your imagination fill in what’s under the robe. 😉

📅 Release Timeline
We’re currently aiming for a late June release, but due to the scope of the update (and a recent overhaul of the animation pipeline), it may slip by 2–3 weeks. We promise — it’ll be worth it.

🔥 What to Expect
🖼️ 1200+ new renders out of 3000 planned (850 already done )

✨ 850+ AI-polished images

🎞️ ~150 animations planned — currently 7% complete

🕒 3–4 hours of new gameplay based on average player data

This release will deliver a rich and layered experience that rewards every choice — visually and narratively. We’re pushing hard to make it the most polished drop so far.

👀 New Character Incoming…
This update also introduces a brand-new character who will play a small but very intriguing role — one that will expand significantly in future episodes. 👁️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/65212b71ee63297d8ddb4dbc455b7630a0b41d58.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support and excitement — we’re getting close!

notes.title: 🌟 Dev Update #4 - Progress & Team Expansion!
notes.content:
Exciting times ahead! We've officially moved into Day 3 development, and I’m thrilled to announce the addition of another stellar Blender artist to our ranks. Her exceptional skills are a perfect fit for the ambitious vision we have for our visual novel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/fd83fde0fe4e4590bc9f097451ac847bb9b79b3f.jpg[/img]

🎨 Content Update:

Day 1 & Day 2 Expansion: We’ve not only doubled the content for Day 1 but also enhanced Day 2 by 150%! New scenes have been added, and existing ones have been expanded to enrich the storytelling experience.

Script Progress: Our writer is on track to finalize the entire script by early next week, ensuring that every narrative thread ties perfectly into the immersive world we're crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/8ac89fdbc2a2c8118114c165308eb4d42fd3750a.jpg[/img]

Blender Team: With a three-person Blender team now, our output capacity has increased. We’re committed to maintaining the highest quality, carefully crafting each scene and occasionally adding more visuals where the story demands.

🚀 Looking Forward: Our journey is speeding up, and your continued support fuels our creativity and dedication. If you're enjoying the ride and can keep supporting us on Patreon, it would mean the world. Every bit helps in bringing this intricate universe to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186602/6e594e850165b88e162f7a26bc8431e379ef681c.jpg[/img]

👀 Stay Tuned: We’ve got some thrilling updates and previews coming your way soon. Your feedback and engagement have been invaluable, so please keep it coming!

Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure. Here’s to crafting stories that captivate and inspire!

Enjoy the 5k wallapers attached!
